title: Korean Online Hate Speech Dataset for Multilabel Classification - How Can Social Science Improve Dataset on Hate Speech? -

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating Korean online news and community comments targeting racial/ethnic minorities and immigrants to construct a multilabel dataset, then evaluating the classification performance of fine-tuned language models (KcBERT, KcELECTRA) using Label Ranking Average Precision (LRAP).
Annotating Korean online comments targeting specific religious groups (e.g., Protestants, Islam, Buddhism) to construct a multilabel dataset, then evaluating fine-tuned language models using LRAP.

Annotating Korean online comments containing derogatory stereotypes aimed at specific geographic regions (e.g., Jeolla-province, Gyeongsang-province) to construct a multilabel dataset, then evaluating fine-tuned language models using LRAP.

Annotating Korean online comments expressing prejudice, gerontophobia, or derogatory language toward specific age groups/generations to construct a multilabel dataset, then evaluating fine-tuned language models using LRAP.

Annotating Korean online comments expressing hostile or benevolent sexism against women and changing family norms to construct a multilabel dataset, then evaluating fine-tuned language models using LRAP.
Annotating Korean online comments explicitly discriminating against sexual minorities (e.g., LGBTQ) to construct a multilabel dataset, then evaluating fine-tuned language models using LRAP.
Annotating Korean online comments containing stigmatizing or hostile expressions targeting males to construct a multilabel dataset, then evaluating fine-tuned language models using LRAP.
